tasks.dev: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp public/logo.svg dist/ && deno bundle --platform browser --outdir dist --watch index.html
tasks.build: deno task build:client && deno task build:rust
tasks.build:client: deno task check && rm -rf dist && deno bundle -q --platform browser --minify --outdir dist index.html && cp public/logo.svg dist/
tasks.test: deno task build:client && deno task test:rust && deno task test:unit
tasks.bench: deno task build:rust && cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --example hook_bench && cargo run --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --example server_bench
